description: The component graph of dcat-ap-plus-p450. Single source of truth: components-graph.md documents it, web/ renders it, the presentation draws from it. Every node id is also an anchor in components-graph.md.

statuses.label: Exists
statuses.description: Implemented and tested in an upstream repository; reused as is.

statuses.label: Adapt
statuses.description: Implemented upstream for another domain; needs P450-specific adaptation.

statuses.label: New
statuses.description: Does not exist anywhere; built in this package.

statuses.label: External
statuses.description: A service or data source outside the user's repositories.

phases.name: Prerequisites
phases.description: Shared core, verdict reconciliation, ladder semantics, HFQ conformance, upstream defects, university compute route.

phases.name: Papers
phases.description: Ladder rewrites of the oscillator papers; the cycle-as-ladder paper.

phases.name: Querying
phases.description: Schema, snapshots, domain modules, named graphs, the HFQ p450 world, Buhera integration.

phases.name: Downstream
phases.description: Refinement, admission, grounding, ontology, metabolite ID, pharmacogenomics, spectroscopy, DDI.

phases.name: Model
phases.description: Training corpus, training on AppHub, merge, evaluation, deployment behind dsl-writer.

layers.name: University compute
layers.description: Where every heavy task runs: AppHub sessions reached through lattice units carried by the university Gitea.

layers.name: Sources
layers.description: External databases and instrument files, read only through dated, content-addressed snapshots.

layers.name: Upstream code
layers.description: Implemented and tested modules in the user's other repositories that this package reuses.

layers.name: Shared core
layers.description: dcat-ap-plus-core: the generic machinery extracted from the chromatography extension, shared by all four extensions.

layers.name: Schema
layers.description: The LinkML P450 extension, its generated OWL/SHACL/JSON-LD, and its audits.

layers.name: Domain modules
layers.description: One module per experimental aspect of P450; each turns snapshots and instrument data into records.

layers.name: Records
layers.description: Named graphs, one per basis, emitted as JSON-LD result files that conform to the shapes and round-trip.

layers.name: Semantics
layers.description: What the records support: refined triples, admission, grounding verdicts, the ontology.

layers.name: Query
layers.description: The HFQ p450 world, ladders, the plan library and the SPARQL endpoint.

layers.name: Runtime (Buhera OS)
layers.description: The OS-wide federation that hosts the library: registry, CKG runtime, modules, front pages.

layers.name: Domain LLM
layers.description: A compiled probe: writes plans, explains verdicts, never states a value no record holds.

layers.name: Papers
layers.description: The argued and validated claims; every paper emits records and ships plans with expected verdicts.

edgeKinds.label: reuses
edgeKinds.description: Code is imported or vendored from the source into the target.

edgeKinds.label: snapshots
edgeKinds.description: A source is fetched into a dated, content-addressed snapshot.

edgeKinds.label: feeds
edgeKinds.description: Data flows from source to target.

edgeKinds.label: emits
edgeKinds.description: A module writes triples into a named graph.

edgeKinds.label: conforms to
edgeKinds.description: Output is validated against a schema or shapes.

edgeKinds.label: analyses
edgeKinds.description: A semantic stage reads records and adds annotations without changing an asserted triple.

edgeKinds.label: queries
edgeKinds.description: A query component reads records or snapshots.

edgeKinds.label: trains
edgeKinds.description: Material enters the model's training corpus.

edgeKinds.label: deploys
edgeKinds.description: A trained artefact is served by a runtime component.

edgeKinds.label: runs on
edgeKinds.description: A computing task is executed on university infrastructure.

edgeKinds.label: documents
edgeKinds.description: A paper argues and validates the claims a component implements.

nodes.label: Uni Gitea
nodes.summary: Carries lattice units to AppHub and results back. levinthal needs a university remote or a tracker sync manifest that hides .claude/.

nodes.label: lattice
nodes.summary: Wraps a task into a runnable unit: works out environment, GPU need, secrets and shards on the laptop; run.sh on AppHub needs only bash and git.

nodes.label: AppHub
nodes.summary: Code-Server sessions with CPU and GPU profiles. Accepts no inbound connection; clones from Gitea, pushes results to lattice-results branches.

nodes.label: AppHubAI
nodes.summary: OpenAI-compatible model endpoint on AppHub. lattice points clients at it; the trained model can be served here.

nodes.label: tracker sync
nodes.summary: Pushes each origin the projection it may see. Used to keep .claude/ and other private paths off the university origin.

nodes.label: experiment ledger
nodes.summary: Experiments planned here and run on AppHub through lattice: a spec per experiment (question, components, target repository, command, pinned requires, checks), an append-only record of every plan, wrap and collection, and verdicts judged here.

nodes.label: UniProt
nodes.summary: Sequences and features of the 57 human CYPs, CPR (POR) and cytochrome b5.

nodes.label: PDB
nodes.summary: CYP structures (1TQN for CYP3A4 and others): heme site, access channels, ligand complexes.

nodes.label: Rhea
nodes.summary: Reactions catalysed by EC 1.14.14.1 and relatives, with ChEBI participants.

nodes.label: KEGG
nodes.summary: Pathways hsa00982, hsa00983 (drug metabolism), hsa00140 (steroids), hsa00590 (arachidonic acid). Licence to check before redistribution.

nodes.label: ChEMBL
nodes.summary: Activities against CYP targets: Ki, IC50, time-dependent inhibition. CC BY-SA.

nodes.label: PharmVar
nodes.summary: Star-allele definitions for CYP2D6, 2C19, 2C9, 3A5, 2B6 and others.

nodes.label: CPIC
nodes.summary: Allele function, activity scores, diplotype-to-phenotype tables, guidelines.

nodes.label: ClinVar
nodes.summary: Variant submissions including drug-response significance; already parsed by the genomics extension.

nodes.label: FDA DDI tables
nodes.summary: Index substrates, inhibitors and inducers by isoform and strength: the reference set for DDI validation.

nodes.label: Spectral libraries
nodes.summary: Reference MS/MS spectra for drugs and metabolites.

nodes.label: Instrument files
nodes.summary: UV-vis (Soret, CO-difference), LC-MS, HPLC raw files from assays.

nodes.label: Monograph corpus
nodes.summary: 21 existing P450 papers with validation scripts; the stated claims the library starts from.

nodes.label: DCAT-AP-PLUS
nodes.summary: The base LinkML schema: Dataset, DataGeneratingActivity, EvaluatedEntity, AgenticEntity, Device, attributes with QUDT.

nodes.label: Chem-DCAT-AP
nodes.summary: Chemistry extension: ChemicalEntity, ChemicalReaction, Catalyst (SIO:010344, slot RXNO:0000425).

nodes.label: chromatography ext.
nodes.summary: Most mature extension (CI, 15 test modules): identifiers, census, refinement, verdicts, linkage, comparability, corroboration. Source of the shared core.

nodes.label: proteomics ext.
nodes.summary: Template layout: sequence mapping, licence-or-decline search, admission, named-graph emission, catalogue.

nodes.label: genomics ext.
nodes.summary: ground.py computes the five semiotic verdicts and Q_g/Q_c/Q_d; ClinVar corpus already holds the CYP genes. clinvar.py:121 collapses drug response.

nodes.label: conspirator ART
nodes.summary: Refined triples at load time, the gate letters (+, -, a, open), determine() closure; papers on SGV and schema admission.

nodes.label: okgg
nodes.summary: Ontological knowledge graph generator: the model proposes distinctions, a lexical witness decides values.

nodes.label: HFQ
nodes.summary: Federated plan language: check before contact, water-filled budget, six verdicts with blockers, blame chains, ladder step. Python holds V1-V16; JS is vendored by Buhera.

nodes.label: HFQ biocat
nodes.summary: Enzyme predicates and adapters (sequence_of, catalysed_reactions, producers_of) with the Doerr Q1-Q5 fixture.

nodes.label: SBS
nodes.summary: Systems-biology circuits: conductance, flux, perturbation, cascade 1-prod(1-k). CYP3A4 kinetic stub only.

nodes.label: seven-state probe panel
nodes.summary: The seven P450 states with UV-vis, EPR, Raman and Mossbauer readouts and an exhaustive minimal-probe search.

nodes.label: ladder engine
nodes.summary: Contact graphs, intensive power, compositions, Machine.runVerdict. Paper/code mismatch: subfloor vs starved, empty vs ParseError.

nodes.label: honjo-masamune
nodes.summary: SMILES reader that tags every atom and bond stated or supplied; the .ms plan language. No d-block: iron is out of scope.

nodes.label: CASMI + matchms
nodes.summary: Formula and adduct by two agreeing determinations; ModifiedCosine for parent-metabolite matching. Element set lacks F, Br, I, Fe; isotope model silently empty.

nodes.label: labdatareader
nodes.summary: JASCO UV-vis spectrum and kinetics readers, plus plate readers.

nodes.label: raw2dcat
nodes.summary: HPLC/GC raw files to Chem-DCAT-AP with stated / indicated / supplied statements. kg/, federation/ hold only __pycache__ on main.

nodes.label: levinthal-core
nodes.summary: Partition states and trajectories. Defects recorded by Buhera: U-lev-2 residue masses ~18.01 Da heavy, U-lev-3 unseeded folding, U-lev-4 constant to_sentropy.

nodes.label: LoRA + TIES recipe
nodes.summary: Qwen2.5 base, LoRA rank 16, TIES merge, held-out evaluation.

nodes.label: corpus builder
nodes.summary: Glossary and document to Q&A with masking; an AppHub training bundle.

nodes.label: identifiers
nodes.summary: SHA-256 canonical digests and Stage(content, conventions): a stored value is valid only for the state it was computed on.

nodes.label: census
nodes.summary: Which distinctions a LinkML schema draws that its emitted RDF cannot carry.

nodes.label: refinement
nodes.summary: Canonical nests over asserted triples: level words, exclusion letters, repetitions, cells, pair status.

nodes.label: verdict lattice
nodes.summary: One documented algebra: the 9 ordered step labels with 6 blockers from chromatography as canonical, HFQ's 6 step verdicts mapped into it, subfloor added for ladders; the 5 semiotic ground verdicts and the gate letters as orthogonal axes.

nodes.label: linkage
nodes.summary: Elimination before ranking: never return a link the data contradicts. Comparability undecided where either side is supplied.

nodes.label: provenance
nodes.summary: Basis tags (stated, supplied, derived) that compose as max; no laundering.

nodes.label: emission
nodes.summary: Named graph per basis, JSON-LD output, SHACL conformance, parse-back round-trip.

nodes.label: artefact generator
nodes.summary: LinkML to OWL, SHACL and JSON-LD context, with the repaired SHACL fixes from genomics.

nodes.label: p450.yaml
nodes.summary: Isoform, Allele, Diplotype, Incubation, KineticMeasurement, Inhibition, Metabolite, CatalyticState, SpectralObservation, CatalystRole with its own IRI.

nodes.label: refined.yaml
nodes.summary: Vocabulary for refined values carried as stage-annotated annotations, never as slots.

nodes.label: OWL / SHACL / context
nodes.summary: Generated from the LinkML; committed so consumers need no toolchain.

nodes.label: receiver audit
nodes.summary: Census plus semiotic receiver audit: zero lost pairs; measured and computed observations keep distinct IRIs.

nodes.label: witness classes
nodes.summary: The declared A_c, U_c, A_d, U_d, G_d classes the grounding queries need.

nodes.label: snapshot fetchers
nodes.summary: One fetcher per source; writes a dated, digest-named snapshot. The only code that touches the network.

nodes.label: isoforms & sequences
nodes.summary: The 57 human CYPs, families and subfamilies, substrate recognition sites, the CYP2D6/CYP2D7 pair.

nodes.label: structures
nodes.summary: PDB and GLB structures, heme site, the glb-structural-input paper's pipeline.

nodes.label: catalytic cycle (ladder)
nodes.summary: Seven states as rungs; composite power; subfloor when a state is missing or uncoupled.

nodes.label: kinetics & inhibition
nodes.summary: Km, Vmax, Ki, IC50, kinact/KI with units and assay conditions; comparability under declared tolerances.

nodes.label: substrate chemistry
nodes.summary: Substrates and inhibitors with stated/supplied structure; candidate sites of metabolism. Never asserts substrate scope from recorded substrates.

nodes.label: metabolite ID
nodes.summary: Biotransformation mass rules (+15.995, -14.016, +176.032, GSH +305.068), licence only when two determinations agree, else decline with reason.

nodes.label: LC corroboration
nodes.summary: Retention corroborates an identity and never establishes it: parent and metabolite peaks as fields.

nodes.label: CYP abundance
nodes.summary: Surrogate peptides per isoform mapped by sequence, Skyline transitions, microsome normalisation.

nodes.label: pharmacogenomics
nodes.summary: Star alleles, diplotype activity score (summed, not averaged), phenotype; CYP2D6 copy number and hybrids.

nodes.label: spectroscopy
nodes.summary: UV-vis readers now; EPR, resonance Raman, Mossbauer readers new. States identified by the minimal probe set.

nodes.label: DDI & clearance
nodes.summary: Inhibition and induction as ladder and cascade steps over drug-metabolism pathways; validated against the FDA index tables.

nodes.label: stated graph
nodes.summary: What a source or instrument file says, verbatim.

nodes.label: supplied graph
nodes.summary: What a convention, a lab or a reference database filled in.

nodes.label: derived graph
nodes.summary: What a computation in this package concluded, including framework quantities such as aperture depth.

nodes.label: refined graph
nodes.summary: Refined values of every asserted triple, stage-annotated (RDF-star).

nodes.label: admitted graph
nodes.summary: Slots admitted under A1-A6 to split cells the schema could not.

nodes.label: result files
nodes.summary: One JSON-LD file per dataset with its manifest; conforms to the shapes and parses back to the same quads.

nodes.label: refined triples + gate
nodes.summary: Empty answers labelled + (witnessed no), - (not recorded), a, open (a name the graph never uses).

nodes.label: schema admission
nodes.summary: Field scores, joins, linking, admitted slots and goals for P450 records.

nodes.label: grounding profile
nodes.summary: The five semiotic verdicts per record; a grounding profile reported beside every answer.

nodes.label: ontology (okgg)
nodes.summary: Facets that tell papers, sections and records apart; proposals for admission.

nodes.label: HFQ p450 world
nodes.summary: Adapters over the snapshots and the records; added upstream in hegel, then vendored into Buhera.

nodes.label: pharmacology predicates
nodes.summary: inhibits, induces, substrate_of, metabolite_of, allele_of, activity_score; numeric range filters with units.

nodes.label: isoform maps
nodes.summary: UniProt, EC, KEGG, PDB, ChEMBL target translation maps; retention and amplification measured, not assumed.

nodes.label: data-derived ladders
nodes.summary: A rung's power taken from a retrieved value or from the ladder engine, instead of a literal.

nodes.label: plan library
nodes.summary: One .hfq plan per claim in the papers, with expected verdicts as tests.

nodes.label: SPARQL endpoint
nodes.summary: SPARQL over the result files; the transaminase KG service with the enzyme swapped.

nodes.label: HFQ conformance
nodes.summary: Python and JS interpreters give identical verdicts on every plan; borgia's copy re-vendored or retired.

nodes.label: Buhera registry
nodes.summary: One registry dispatches about 40 modules; science modules vendored byte-exact with pinned commits and specs.

nodes.label: CKG runtime
nodes.summary: Catalytic states as nodes, modules fold value-deltas onto them. Facts must carry their basis and verdict.

nodes.label: cytochrome module
nodes.summary: Today holds monograph constants; becomes queries over the records.

nodes.label: hfq module
nodes.summary: Vendored hegel JS interpreter; gains the p450 world when re-vendored.

nodes.label: ladder module
nodes.summary: Vendored ladder engine; computes powers a plan's ladder step can use.

nodes.label: dsl-writer
nodes.summary: Natural language to a DSL script, validated by the real compiler, repaired on failure, dispatched.

nodes.label: /protein-modelling
nodes.summary: The live report and IDE; its numbers will come from the records.

nodes.label: p450 front page
nodes.summary: This site: the component graph, the phases, a page per component.

nodes.label: training corpus
nodes.summary: Question to plan; plan to verdict to explanation, refusals included; paper sections to Q&A; record graphs to descriptions. Licences filtered.

nodes.label: LoRA training
nodes.summary: Qwen2.5 base, LoRA; wrapped as a lattice unit with a seed and size matrix.

nodes.label: TIES merge
nodes.summary: Merges adapters trained on separate corpus slices.

nodes.label: evaluation
nodes.summary: Plans parse and pass check; verdicts match reference plans; refuses when it should; zero values not backed by a record; dsl-writer repair rate.

nodes.label: serving
nodes.summary: Served on AppHubAI or locally; called by dsl-writer for dslId hfq, later ladder and shapeshifter.

nodes.label: ladder rewrites (6)
nodes.summary: Expression algebra, multi-hop ET, address manifold, resting/bound states, Compound I, introduction: oscillator dynamics replaced by ladders.

nodes.label: records sections (15)
nodes.summary: Every paper gains 'Records and queries': the triples it emits, the plans that answer it, the cells it cannot separate.

nodes.label: N1 schema
nodes.summary: The P450 extension of DCAT-AP-PLUS, its census and receiver audit.

nodes.label: N2 cycle as ladder
nodes.summary: Seven states as rungs; absorbs the closed-orbit paper.

nodes.label: N3 federated querying
nodes.summary: Snapshots, predicates, isoform maps, and the position on substrate scope.

nodes.label: N4 metabolite ID
nodes.summary: Biotransformation rules with licence or decline, corroborated by retention.

nodes.label: N5 PGx admission
nodes.summary: Star alleles, activity scores, which genotype fields to admit.

nodes.label: N6 DDI propagation
nodes.summary: Inhibition and induction as ladder and cascade propagation.

nodes.label: N7 spectroscopic discrimination
nodes.summary: The minimal probe set that separates the seven states.

nodes.label: N8 domain model
nodes.summary: The model as a compiled probe, and its evaluation.
